activity_summary: At nine you left the plot as it was. The note stays the note, and you did not write a new height for Nick. You did not make a new entrance.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Checked the plot and added nothing.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Named on the plot, and not given a higher note.

facets.activity: Read the plot and put Nick's note back on the peg
